evidence_required: one sentence per strategy, plus the interference mechanism in terms of iterations

marking.criterion: Static batching: fixed batch run to completion, early finishers idle
Dynamic batching: batch formed on size or timeout, still run to completion
Continuous batching: admit/retire at every iteration (Orca)
Interference: a new request's prefill occupies an iteration (or part, with chunking), so running sequences get no or slower tokens

title: Static, dynamic and continuous batching
